hero.name: The Doppelgänger
hero.specialAbility:
STILL WATERS
If the final combat values are exactly equal, the combat has no winner. (Equality only — over-defending still loses the attack normally.)

EQUILIBRIUM
After a combat with no winner, the Doppelgänger holds EQUILIBRIUM. It holds until any combat has a winner — including one the Doppelgänger wins.
hero.quote: An original folklore duelist: the mirror-double that fights you to a standstill. It wins nothing and loses nothing, and every stalemate leaves it a little more balanced.

cards.afterText: If the combat had no winner, deal 1 damage to the opposing fighter and draw 1 card.
cards.duringText: You may set this card's value equal to the opposing card's value.
cards.title: Step for Step

cards.afterText: If you won the combat, your opponent discards 1 card at random.
cards.duringText: If you hold EQUILIBRIUM, this card's value is 5.
cards.title: The Omen

cards.afterText: If you won the combat, deal 1 damage to each opposing fighter adjacent to the Doppelgänger.
cards.duringText: If you hold EQUILIBRIUM, this card's value is increased by 2 and you lose EQUILIBRIUM.
cards.title: Shatter the Glass

cards.afterText: If the combat had no winner, draw 2 cards.
cards.duringText: You may set this card's value equal to the opposing card's value.
cards.title: Perfect Reflection

cards.afterText: If the combat had no winner, the Doppelgänger recovers 2 health. If you lost the combat, draw 1 card.
cards.title: Silvered Glass

cards.basicText: The Doppelgänger holds EQUILIBRIUM. Draw 1 card.
cards.title: Pale Company

cards.basicText: Place the Doppelgänger in a space adjacent to an opposing fighter. Draw 1 card.
cards.title: Walk Beside You

cards.basicText: Choose one — if you hold EQUILIBRIUM, choose two instead: draw 2 cards; move the Doppelgänger up to 3 spaces, moving through fighters; deal 1 damage to an opposing fighter in the Doppelgänger's zone.
cards.title: Hall of Mirrors

cards.afterText: If the combat had no winner, you may move the Doppelgänger up to 2 spaces.
cards.duringText: If you hold EQUILIBRIUM, this card's value is increased by 2.
cards.title: Your Own Reflection

cards.afterText: If the combat had no winner: if you played this card as an attack, gain 1 action; otherwise draw 1 card.
cards.title: The Glass Between

cards.immediateText: Cancel all effects on your opponent's card.
cards.title: Feint

cards.afterText: Draw 1 card. If you won the combat, draw 2 cards instead.
cards.title: Regroup

name: The Doppelgänger
